newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell CEO offers projections - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell CEO offers projections - Barron's.

text.p: Honeywell Inc Chief Executive Mike Bonsignore expects annual sales to increase by between eight percent and 10 percent for "the next few years," according to a story published in Barron's.
The newspaper quoted Bonsignore as saying the company's margins also were expected to gain 1 percent to 1.5 percent over the next few years, representing double-digit earnings growth.
Barron's said those estimates may be on the conservative side since the company has been seeking to eliminate its "vulnerability to economic cycles."
First Call's mean estimates project Honeywell earning $3.68 per share in 1997, and $4.22 per share in 1998.
